title: Scalable Inversion of Contests with Correlated Performances, Including Softmax and Multinomial Probit
abstract: arXiv:2609.01133v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multinomial probit choice probabilities over n alternatives are Gaussian orthant integrals, computed by simulation for thirty years, one expensive integral per alternative. Inversion, which is to say determining item attractiveness consistent with a prescribed choice probability vector, is even more difficult and has been considered impractical for correlated contests when n is large. Yet here, for families lying within a grammar including factor, block and hierarchical covariance structures, we exhibit a calibration tested at n = 1,000,000 reproducing probabilities to very high accuracy, even in the extreme tail. We must return to much smaller problems for any performance comparison to be possible due to limitations of the prior art. translated_title: 具有相关性能竞赛的可扩展反演方法：涵盖Softmax与多项式Probit
translated_abstract: 多项式probit模型在n个备选项上的选择概率是高斯卦限积分，三十年来一直通过模拟方法计算，每个备选项都需要一次代价高昂的积分。反演，即确定与给定选择概率向量相一致的项目吸引力，则更加困难，长期以来在n较大时对于存在相关性的竞赛被认为不可行。然而，本文针对一个涵盖因子、块和分层协方差结构的文法框架内的若干族，展示了一种校准方法，在n=1,000,000的规模下经测试能够以极高精度重现概率，即使在极端尾部也是如此。由于现有技术的限制，任何性能比较都只能在规模小得多的问题上进行。Geweke-Hajivassiliou-Keane模拟器是标准方法（对于高秩问题仍然适用），但在n=200时已经慢了约两百倍，且其实测成本大致按n^2.8增长，而我们的方法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对具有相关性能的竞赛（包括Softmax与多项式Probit）提出一种可扩展的反演校准方法，能在备选项数高达一百万时以极高精度重现选择概率，而标准GHK模拟器在n=200时已慢两百倍、成本约按n^2.8增长。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a scalable calibration for inverting contests with correlated performances (including softmax and multinomial probit), reproducing choice probabilities to very high accuracy at n = 1,000,000, whereas the standard GHK simulator is already two hundred times slower at n = 200 with cost growing roughly as n^2.8.
